items.quote: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD
items.claim: Abraham got up early in the morning at the place where he stood before the LORD
items.place: the place where he stood before the LORD

items.quote: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain
items.claim: Abraham looked toward Sodom, Gomorrah, and the land of the plain
items.object: Sodom and Gomorrah, all the land of the plain

items.quote: and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace
items.claim: Abraham beheld the smoke of the country rising like smoke from a furnace
